hint.nudge.G01: Today I’m doing Gran’s shopping and then going to her workshop. I don’t leave home without my tools.
hint.nudge.G02: I can’t sort out Gran’s shopping on my own. The pick-up point knows who carries whose shopping round here.
hint.where.G02: At the pick-up point by Lúčny koník.
hint.nudge.G03: I’ve got Gran’s list, but not the bag of shopping yet. Apparently it’s waiting for me somewhere, ready.
hint.where.G03: At the shop at the hatch, with Dana.
hint.nudge.G04: The bag is full. Gran’s rule: I don’t go into the house; I leave the shopping outside.
hint.nudge.G05: The shopping’s delivered. Gran wanted to tell me something else, but only at the window.
hint.where.G05: Below Gran’s closed window. She can’t hear me through the glass.
hint.nudge.G06: An unplugged device is making noises in Gran’s workshop. And I’m already carrying the key.
hint.where.G06: The workshop stands in the garden behind Mira’s gate.
hint.nudge.G07: In the porch there’s something that looks very important, and yet it isn’t locked.
hint.where.G07: In the porch of the garden workshop.
hint.nudge.G08: The base node isn’t lit. A good repairer finds out why first, and only then changes anything.
hint.where.G08: In the back room of the workshop, where ZVON stands.
hint.nudge.G09: I’ve got the blown fuse in my hand. I’m sure I have an identical replacement somewhere at home.
hint.nudge.G10: The spare fuse has the same ratings as the blown one. It belongs exactly where I took the old one out.
hint.where.G10: In the back room of Gran’s workshop.
hint.nudge.G11: The device wants three reference shapes. It looks like a building set for nursery children, only pricier.
hint.where.G11: The colours don’t matter; the shape does. The diagram above the panel shows what goes with what.
hint.nudge.B01: The device has sent me to my old school. Before I barge in anywhere, I’ll find out what’s going on here today.
hint.where.B01: Outside Sokolíkova School, by the noticeboard.
hint.nudge.B02: You report to the caretaker. But he won’t just let a stranger off the street any further.
hint.where.B02: In the school’s entrance hall, with the caretaker.
hint.nudge.B03: That device is Gran’s. If anyone knows what’s happening to it, it’s her, even in 1995.
hint.where.B03: In the memory club classroom at the end of the corridor.
hint.nudge.B04: Gran wants the tape from the school PA. But the tape recorder is holding on to it and won’t let go.
hint.where.B04: In the school PA room, by the tape recorder.
hint.nudge.B05: The drive belt has perished into pieces. I’ll only get an identical one at a repair shop that keeps belts by the drawerful.
hint.where.B05: At the repair shop in Karlova Ves.
hint.nudge.B06: The new drive belt is a perfect fit. I pulled the old one out of one very stubborn tape recorder.
hint.where.B06: Back in the school PA room.
hint.nudge.B07: You can hardly hear the voices on the tape. Pali mentioned someone who can work magic with tapes.
hint.where.B07: At the cassette club in Ružinov, with Juro.
hint.nudge.B08: The adaptor is missing a connector, and Fero has one. A repairer always comes in handy at the market.
hint.where.B08: At Miletičova among the stalls, with Fero.
hint.nudge.B09: I won’t plug bare leads into the school PA. Juro said who has an insulating sleeve.
hint.where.B09: At the tailor’s next to the market, with Milada.
hint.nudge.B10: I have all the parts of the lead. Now they need putting together; the contacts have matching marks.
hint.where.B10: I can put this together from things I’m already carrying in my bag.
hint.nudge.B11: The contacts match, but the leads are bare. Without insulation I won’t plug it into the school PA.
hint.where.B11: I can finish this in my bag too; no need to go anywhere.
hint.nudge.B12: The lead is finished. The tape has to be played so the tracks don’t cancel out, without recording anything on it.
hint.where.B12: In the school PA room, by the tape recorder.
hint.nudge.B13: Gran gave me a letter of authority. With it, somewhere in the centre, they’ll give me a copy of the map.
hint.where.B13: In the archive reading room in Staré Mesto, with Mr Merta.
hint.nudge.B14: The number of the missing overlay is on the negative. But someone has to develop it first.
hint.where.B14: At the Svetlo photo studio, on the other side of the square.
hint.nudge.B15: The photo shows the number K-17. Alena said who has the old map supplements.
hint.where.B15: At the Second Hand bookshop, with Viera.
hint.nudge.B16: The map is almost complete. The missing layer is already in my bag; it just doesn’t line up yet.
hint.where.B16: Hole on hole, cross on cross, square on square. If the marks don’t line up, turn the overlay.
hint.nudge.B17: The map is complete. Now someone who helped draw it once needs to read it.
hint.where.B17: The map leads to a garage in Petržalka.
hint.nudge.B18: The measurement needs a rhythm that doesn’t depend on electricity. Dezider said who has a metronome.
hint.where.B18: At the Karlova Ves tram stop, with Emil.
hint.nudge.B19: Gran didn’t write the three digits for the stand as numbers. She painted them as a picture.
hint.where.B19: At Pri LEALe, on the wall.
hint.nudge.B20: Dezider gave me a coil. Without it, nothing gets measured at the measuring point.
hint.where.B20: In the measuring booth on Starý most.
hint.nudge.B21: I have the metronome. The measurement needs a rhythm and a level spot where nothing will rock it.
hint.where.B21: By the measuring booth on Starý most, next to the stand.
hint.nudge.B22: The stand wants the three digits Gran drew on the wall. I need the tape and the map with me as well.
hint.where.B22: Each dial is one digit from the rhythm drawing: waves, beats, segments, in that order.
hint.nudge.I01: I’m in Ivanka in 1962. ZVON comes from here, so I’m looking for the workshop where they built it.
hint.where.I01: In the mechanical workshop in Ivanka.
hint.nudge.I02: Oto gave me a slip for leather and rivets. Here materials are only issued against a signed slip.
hint.where.I02: In the farm workshop yard, with the storeman.
hint.nudge.I03: Lída in the hall has the punch. Oto says she’ll lend it to me if I help her with something.
hint.where.I03: In the village hall, where a rehearsal is being prepared.
hint.nudge.I04: The leather for the cuff is pre-cut, but the marked holes haven’t been punched yet.
hint.where.I04: I’ll do this in my bag with what I’ve already got.
hint.nudge.I05: The holes are punched. But for now the cuff is held together only by goodwill.
hint.where.I05: I can finish this in my bag too.
hint.nudge.I06: The cuff is finished. All that’s left is to go back to the thing that leaks without it.
hint.where.I06: Outside the hut behind the park.
hint.nudge.I07: The water is circulating again. Whoever holds the key to the measuring room should know.
hint.where.I07: In the mechanical workshop, with Oto.
hint.nudge.I08: I have the key to the measuring room. I’ve already seen its door today.
hint.where.I08: Outside the hut behind the park.
hint.nudge.I09: Behind the door, young Gran is at work. I have to tell her what the future does to original data.
hint.where.I09: In the measuring room, with young Mira.
hint.nudge.I10: The imprint needs a blunt stylus too. Mira said who carries one in a case.
hint.where.I10: In the manor house park, with Vera on the bench.
hint.nudge.I11: You don’t take an imprint on just any paper. Mira knows where the right kind is.
hint.nudge.I12: The plate has to stay where it is. I’ll only take its imprint away.
hint.where.I12: In the room of the first ZVON.
hint.nudge.I13: The relief is on the paper, but the edges are faint. I have a borrowed tool for bringing out edges.
hint.where.I13: I’ll finish this in my bag.
hint.nudge.I14: I need the registration form twice, exactly the same. I’m not copying it out by hand.
hint.where.I14: At the post office, by the counter.
hint.nudge.I15: I can make the second copy of the form myself. I already have everything I need for it.
hint.where.I15: I’ll do this in my bag.
hint.nudge.I16: Both forms are the same. But someone with a stamp has to confirm their date.
hint.where.I16: At the post office, with Mr Baran behind the counter.
hint.nudge.I17: The form is stamped. Now it needs storing so it survives for decades. I’m keeping the imprint with me.
hint.nudge.C01: The imprint from 1962 is verified. Gran will know what comes next, even if I only see her through the glass.
hint.where.C01: In Grob, below Gran’s closed window.
hint.nudge.D01: Gran wanted me to remember the school yard exactly as it is today. I don’t trust my memory, but I trust my phone.
hint.where.D01: Outside the school on Sokolíkova in 2020.
hint.nudge.D02: Tóno knows I’m coming for Gran’s things. I’ll just show him I’m not some stranger off the street.
hint.where.D02: At the caretaker’s service window in 2020.
hint.nudge.D03: Oto built the bridge in 1982. A craftsman like him will have written everything down.
hint.where.D03: In the physics prep room in 2020.
hint.nudge.D04: The record has an exact date. To travel to that year, I need a clock that remembers it.
hint.nudge.E01: In 1982 little Tóno helped Oto. They might both recognise the device I’m carrying.
hint.where.E01: At the school’s service window in 1982, with Tóno and his grandad.
hint.nudge.E02: It isn’t enough to tell a twelve-year-old boy I’m from the future. He has to see it.
hint.where.E02: At the service window, with little Tóno.
hint.nudge.E03: Oto has signed a slip for the bridge parts. Now someone has to issue them to me.
hint.where.E03: At the school maintenance store. You get in through the estate shop by the stop.
hint.nudge.E04: I have the parts and Oto’s drawing. But the bridge won’t assemble itself, and I’m not building it on my knees.
hint.where.E04: In the physics prep room in 1982.
hint.nudge.E05: The bridge will wait in the low wall for decades. It needs a dry container that closes properly.
hint.where.E05: At the estate shop by the stop.
hint.nudge.E06: The bridge mustn’t get damp. Everything that will protect it is already in my bag.
hint.where.E06: I’ll do this in my bag; no need to go anywhere.
hint.nudge.E07: On my photo from 2020 there’s no lime tree here. A cart that runs right past it isn’t helping.
hint.where.E07: In the school garden shed by the yard.
hint.nudge.E08: The jar is sealed. Oto mentioned a place where it will stay untouched until 2020.
hint.where.E08: In the school yard with the young lime.
hint.nudge.E09: I’m carrying the parts of the tree guard. But in the yard they aren’t protecting anything yet.
hint.where.E09: In the school yard with the young lime.
hint.nudge.E10: The guard is up and the jar is hidden. For it to survive future changes to the yard, someone has to write it down.
hint.where.E10: In the garden shed, with Šimon.
hint.nudge.E11: Little Tóno wanted me to say the agreed sentence when we next met. In 1995 he’s the caretaker.
hint.where.E11: In 1995, in the school’s entrance hall, with Tóno.
hint.nudge.D05: The jar has been waiting in the low wall in the yard since 1982. Tóno’s sketches say exactly behind which stone.
hint.where.D05: The sketch and Tóno’s note still apply in 2020: count the row from the top and the stone from the left.
hint.nudge.D06: The jar is out and the seal is holding. But after so many years, the lid won’t give by hand.
hint.where.D06: I’ll do this in my bag; no need to go anywhere.
hint.nudge.D07: The bridge survived. The first to see it should be the one who remembered the place all his life.
hint.where.D07: At the caretaker’s service window in 2020, with Tóno.
hint.nudge.C02: Gran wanted Ela and me to finish the paperwork for her box. That paperwork is still missing.
hint.where.C02: At the pick-up point by Lúčny koník, with Ela.
hint.nudge.C03: The record is missing its signatures. Someone did carry that box with their own hands.
hint.where.C03: In the lane between the fences, by Roman’s van.
hint.nudge.C04: Roman has signed for the collection. The second signature belongs to the woman who handed the box over.
hint.where.C04: At the pick-up point, with Ela.
hint.nudge.C05: The evidence is all together. The device this all started with should know what to do with it.
hint.nudge.F01: Gran’s collection Z-17 ended up with Atlas at Jasná. Someone there must be responsible for it.
hint.nudge.F02: Without a reader I can’t compare the 1995 tape with anything. Nina said who would lend me one.
hint.where.F02: In the lobby of Hotel Grand Jasná, with Tamara.

hint.where.F03: In the hotel’s exhibition room, with Boris.

hint.where.F04: At the Biela Púť customer centre, with Sára.

hint.where.J04: In the Funitel cabin, by the window.

hint.where.F06: In the Atlas service pavilion by the Rotunda.
hint.nudge.F07: The terminal still lacks a local trace. Nina said where I can capture it without touching anything.
hint.where.F07: By Vrbické pleso, at the path. Down by cable car, then on foot from the hotel.

hint.where.F08: In the Atlas service pavilion, at the terminal.
hint.nudge.J05: The switch won’t change anything until the return is safe. I put something aside for that back in 1982.
hint.where.J05: On the viewing terrace by the Rotunda.
hint.nudge.F09: The return is secured. Now the erasing itself has to stop. Nina said how.
hint.where.F09: On the viewing terrace, at the switch.
hint.nudge.F10: The write has stopped. The system will only let me into the chamber with Viktor once I confirm it.
hint.where.F10: In the service pavilion, at the terminal.
hint.nudge.F11: Viktor has to hear what his system threw away. All of it, pauses and all.
hint.nudge.F12: Four ports, four pieces of evidence. The first belongs to how it all began.
hint.where.F12: In the chronochamber, at the ports of the restore panel.
hint.nudge.F13: The next port wants a voice. The original, not a summary.
hint.where.F13: In the chronochamber, at the ports of the restore panel.
hint.nudge.F14: The next port wants proof that Gran consented to her collection being moved.
hint.where.F14: In the chronochamber, at the ports of the restore panel.
hint.nudge.F15: The last port belongs to how things get put back. Nina signed that piece of paper.
hint.where.F15: In the chronochamber, at the ports of the restore panel.
hint.nudge.F16: The panel wants a year for each port. Each piece of evidence carries its own.
hint.where.F16: Each port gets the year of the evidence inside it. The items and the notebook will help.
hint.nudge.F17: Everything is in its place. One last confirmation, and then home.
hint.where.F17: In the chronochamber, at the restore panel.
